goal: Build an AI agent skill engine framework inspired by OpenSpace: self-evolving AI agents that learn, improve, and share skills. Include: skill engine (skill store, versioning, ranking, evolution with auto-fix/auto-improve/auto-learn), agent system (task execution, planning, multi-step reasoning), LLM integration layer (provider abstraction, prompt management, response parsing), cloud skill sharing (skill community, publishing, discovery), recording system (execution tracking, feedback loops), configuration management, MCP protocol server, dashboard server, tool abstraction layer, and utility modules. The system should support skill versioning, quality monitoring, automatic repair, and collective intelligence across agents.
